regional_compliance.tax_context: Federal excise tax on alcohol production (rate varies by beverage type and production volume, with reduced rates for small brewers), plus state excise taxes that vary significantly by state.
regional_compliance.labor_regulation: Federal and state minimum wage applies to bar staff; tip credit rules for bartenders/servers vary by state, similar to restaurants.
regional_compliance.licensing_bodies: TTB (Alcohol and Tobacco Tax and Trade Bureau) federal permit, state liquor control board/authority, local business and health permits. Three-tier distribution system applies in most states.

humanity_mode_regional_addendum.0_percent: Federal TTB excise tax tiers based on annual production volume, state-level excise tax stacking, three-tier distribution licensing requirements.

learning_objectives: Understand how federal TTB excise tax rates scale with annual production volume for small brewers.
Analyze how the three-tier distribution system shapes which licenses a brewery needs depending on how it sells (taproom vs. wholesale).

hardStops: Never takes real-world action without HITL approval
Never modifies data outside declared permissionScope
